summary.text: Travis Sitzmann is a Republican member of the Iowa House of Representatives, District 13, who took office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Ken Carlson, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: For 2025-2026 Sitzmann serves on the Agriculture, Economic Growth, Environmental Protection and Labor committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary, receiving 99.2 percent of the vote, and the Democratic primary for the seat was canceled.
